title: An algebraic stack has unramified diagonal exactly when it admits a surjective etale scheme presentation

standard_prerequisites.name: Explicit prerequisite boundary
standard_prerequisites.reference: Stable Stacks tags retained in assembly.external_references
standard_prerequisites.use: Algebraic stacks, residual gerbes, smooth and unramified morphisms, regular local rings and regular sequences, etale localization, openness and finite-type points. The local slicing and DM residual-gerbe arguments are retained author proof.

core_obligations: Pass from unramified diagonal to finite-type residual gerbes with etale field charts, retaining the full local gerbe argument.
Cut a smooth scheme presentation by a fibrewise regular sequence to make the local chart etale, then assemble charts covering all finite-type points.

proof_roadmap.step: Pass from unramified diagonal to finite-type residual gerbes with etale field charts, retaining the full local gerbe argument.
Cut a smooth scheme presentation by a fibrewise regular sequence to make the local chart etale, then assemble charts covering all finite-type points.

difficulty_reason: The unramified diagonal is only local stabilizer information; an etale scheme presentation must still be constructed. The residual-gerbe and regular-sequence slicing route gives concrete H2 work, even after standard stack foundations are granted.

compared.difference: This migrates the existing unpublished research record, not an additional count beside it.

dedup.scope: Compared fixed tag/file/claim against local manifest, same-chapter primary titles/locators, 400 retired claims, research main-overlap and preparation worklist. Related standard tools and included support are not separately counted. No remote freshness or historical novelty asserted.
